title: Occupancy and Residency Certification: Documented-Return Allowance
content:
When an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile's passed due date is re-dated on the borrower's return home, the return allowance includes a **documented-return allowance**, read from the accepted return-home notice about the primary borrower received most recently:

| The return notice carries a document reference | The return notice came by mail | Documented-return allowance |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 14 days |
| yes | no | 7 days |
| no | yes | 7 days |
| no | no | zero days |

*Hypothetical case.* A return notice submitted through the servicing portal with a hospital discharge summary referenced: one of the two holds, so the allowance is 7 days.
